prompts.title: Amber Glow Birthday
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical, ultra-realistic celebratory birthday poster in 4:5 aspect ratio. The composition should feel like a luxury editorial birthday card with integrated modern graphic design elements. Medium shot framing showing subject from approximately mid-thigh to slightly above head.
Face Matching Requirement:

Use the provided reference image for accurate face and Identity matching. Preserve the subject’s exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, eyebrow shape, lip shape, nose structure, and overall identity. Maintain realism and likeness accuracy while enhancing lighting and cinematic quality. Do not alter core facial features.
Subject Description
A woman with a radiant, flawless natural complexion. She maintains a gentle, serene smile and direct eye contact with the viewer. Her expression is calm, welcoming, and confident.

Natural facial contours
Natural hair voluminous cascading to her collarbones and down her back
Individual hair strands should be sharply detailed and realistic
Makeup is soft and natural
Skin should appear naturally luminous, not overly airbrushed
Pose & Styling
She stands in an elegant three-quarter pose:

Body angled slightly to her right
Head turned forward facing camera
Hands delicately clasped at lower waist
She wears a flowing, long-sleeved white Anarkali-style gown made of satin or silk-blend fabric with a soft sheen. mid sleevs.
Details:

Tone-on-tone pale gold floral and vine embroidery across bodice, neckline, and sleeve cuffs
Heavy natural pleats in the skirt
Realistic fabric folds and soft shadowing
Accessories:

Delicate gold teardrop dangling earrings
Thin intricately linked gold bracelet on left wrist
Background & Graphic Design
Base background: textured cream/off-white canvas.
Behind her head & shoulders:

A perfectly solid, vibrant yellow circle creating a modern halo effect with vignette effect. no overlays inside.

Decorative overlays:
Monochromatic botanical line-art illustrations (leaves, stems, large flowers) in pale gold, beige, bronze
Subtle metallic gold brushstroke textures in the corners
Typography:

Left side: “21 | 03” in bold metallic gold sans-serif font
Right side (vertical orientation): “– HAPPY BIRTHDAY – [NAME]” in bold metallic gold sans-serif font
Text should appear premium, slightly embossed or metallic
Lighting & Rendering
Soft cinematic directional lighting from top-left
Gentle highlights on left side of face and hairs
Subtle shadowing on right side
Soft drop shadow behind her right shoulder
Color palette:

Creamy whites
Vibrant golden-yellow
Metallic gold accents
Warm skin tones
Deep dark hair contrast

8K-Ultra-realistic
Cinematic
High dynamic range
Crisp embroidery details
Visible hair strand definition
Sharp focus across subject and typography
